jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Platform & Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors https://www.skydio.com/solutions/energy-and-utilities to first responders https://www.skydio.com/solutions/public-safety, soldiers in battlefield scenarios https://www.skydio.com/solutions/national-security/tactical-isr, and beyond https://www.skydio.com/solutions.

About the Role:
We deliver life-saving information as fast as possible to our customers. They need to securely engage with our cloud every minute of every day, and our North Star is that stronger security, broader compliance, and more flexible deployment models must never slow or fracture that experience. Our vision is to give customers the flexibility and security they require — multi-cloud, multi-region, and government-grade compliance — without any tradeoffs in speed, reliability, or ease of use.



We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to own and execute the Cloud Platform & Infrastructure roadmap, delivering the multi-cloud, multi-region and government-compliant platform capabilities Skydio needs to scale globally for federal, state & local, and commercial customers. You will also own Skydio’s on-prem product line—productizing air-gapped and self-hosted deployments into a scalable, secure, and high-impact solution.



This senior individual-contributor role is about turning field and sales pain into a tightly scoped, customer-centric roadmap and driving the cross-functional programs that bring it to market. You’ll work closely with SRE, cloud engineering, security & compliance, legal, GTM, and executive leadership to build the platform foundations that unlock growth — all while protecting the fast, simple, frictionless experience our customers depend on.



Location

This position is based onsite 5 days/week at our HQ in San Mateo, CA with 25-30% travel to customers, as needed. We offer generous relocation assistance.



How you'll make an impact:

 - Customer & sales engagement: Run discovery with government and commercial customers: Surface the “why”, build business case for investment, validate proposed solutions in the field, and help grow the business by providing platform capabilities with clearly communicated delivery expectations.

 - Own the platform roadmap for Cloud Platform & Infrastructure: work with sales, customer success, deployment engineers, and customers to convert recurring pain and opportunities into a prioritized, outcome-focused platform roadmap with clear user stories and success criteria.

 - Productize and deliver Skydio On-Prem: Define the roadmap for air-gapped and self-hosted offerings; lead cross-functional delivery (engineering, SRE, security, legal, GTM); own releases, onboarding/runbooks and launch artifacts; run pilots/rollouts to cut time-to-deploy and manual effort while preserving a secure, frictionless experience; and support exponential growth in the national security business.

 - Release & expectation management: Coordinate release planning, cut-downs and “what’s in/what’s out” decisions, and communicate release tradeoffs to internal teams and customers. Ensure customer feedback and bug reports are tracked and routed into the right engineering backlog.

 - Compliance enablement: Translate FedRAMP/CJIS/other regulatory requirements into product and operational requirements; run cross-functional compliance programs and vendor/auditor interactions to achieve certification readiness. You will coordinate auditors, security, legal and engineering - not act as the security architect.

 - Evangelize & enable: Explain platform capabilities across the org, create internal playbooks/artifacts, and help GTM teams present platform value to customers.



What would make you a strong fit:

 - Exceptional product judgment. You can hear five different customer complaints and recognize the one platform capability that resolves all of them. You've turned messy field pain into a prioritized roadmap and driven it to completion across teams you don't manage. You're equally credible setting strategy with executives and cutting scope with an engineer.

 - 8+ years product experience shipping cloud platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing products - or adjacent technical products, with the ability to get to working knowledge of unfamiliar infrastructure quickly. You don't need to be an infrastructure expert; you need engineers to respect you in a design review.

 - Demonstrated track record of turning customer pain into a prioritized roadmap and driving cross-functional programs to completion.

 - Experience shipping products under regulatory constraint. FedRAMP, CJIS, or DoD RMF is ideal, but SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI, or financial regulatory work counts. What matters is that audit and certification requirements have shaped what you could build, and you've run the organizational work to meet them — not that you've done it in a federal context. You can translate regulatory controls into product requirements and run the organizational workstreams to meet them.

 - Track record of shipping platform features that materially improved reliability, scalability, security, and/or cost. Comfortable making tradeoffs and driving decisions with incomplete data.

 - Strong program management and stakeholder influence skills — you can align engineering, security, legal, sales, and customers toward common goals without formal authority.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills; experience briefing executives and external auditors.

 - This role will be driving the development of products for our military customers, and is subject to U.S. export control laws and government contract requirements. As a result, this position is open only to U.S. citizens or Green Card holders. Skydio does not offer employment-based visa or permanent residency sponsorship for this role.

 - Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.



Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $230,000 - $280,000*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.



*Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.

jobs.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors https://www.skydio.com/solutions/energy-and-utilities to first responders https://www.skydio.com/solutions/public-safety, soldiers in battlefield scenarios https://www.skydio.com/solutions/national-security/tactical-isr, and beyond https://www.skydio.com/solutions.

About the Role

As a Hardware Product Management Intern, you will work closely with our customers and our hardware and embedded software engineering teams to help define and shape Skydio’s current and next-gen drone platforms, controllers, cameras, and accessories ecosystem. This is an incredible opportunity to learn Hardware + Software Product Management, drive key decisions, ship products to customers, and ultimately make an impact on the tools that our customers use in service of public safety, national security, and delivering safe and reliable power.


Location

This position is based onsite 5 days/week at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

Examples of how you'll make an impact:

 - Drive definition on portions of our existing and next-generation hardware products, including drones, controllers, cameras, and accessories, translating to impact on actual products shipped.

 - Engage with customers, prospects, and internal stakeholders to understand core business problems to inform execution on projects.

 - Draw upon direct customer experiences and ride-alongs as well as usage analytics to inform execution on projects.

 - Develop, own, and publish product requirement documents for portions of Skydio’s vehicle hardware, controllers, cameras/sensors and embedded software.

 - Partner with designers and engineering leaders spanning hardware, firmware, computer vision, AI, and machine learning to execute on self-contained projects that are expected to ship during the internship or shortly after.

 - Capture, document, and distill feedback from customers and prospects to steer product development.

 - Collaborate closely with sales and customer success to build and maintain close customer relationships and ensure success.

 - Partner with product marketing to develop launch plans, product positioning and messaging to bring our products to market.

 - Collaborate closely with our Go To Market Strategy team to forecast demand and price products.

 

What would make you a good fit:

 - You have a track record of success, demonstrating high ownership and high agency in fast-paced work environments.

 - You are a clear and effective communicator in both technical and story-telling contexts.

 - You are an exceptional critical thinker who loves to learn and can process and leverage new information very rapidly.

 - You are a team player who is willing to take on any task, big or small, to get the job done.

 - You have strong spatial and mechanical reasoning ability.

 - You love to get out “in the field” in order to learn first-hand.

 - You have a great sense for risk management and are very comfortable forming strong opinions with partial or incomplete information.

 - You have strong business acumen and can approach problems either from a top-down business perspective or a bottom-up technical perspective.

 - Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.

 

Other qualifications that are a plus, but not required:

 - A background in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or computer science.

 - An advanced degree, or degree in progress, such as an MBA

 - Aviation or drone experience

 - Experience with IOT or networked devices

 - Experience working in one of our core verticals (Law Enforcement, National Security, Electrical Utilities)

 - Experience with enterprise/professional robotics or drones

 - Direct or indirect experience with engineering that allows you to actively participate in deep discussions with engineers on complex technical architecture challenges and tradeoffs.

Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Telecommunications
jobs.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors https://www.skydio.com/solutions/energy-and-utilities to first responders https://www.skydio.com/solutions/public-safety, soldiers in battlefield scenarios https://www.skydio.com/solutions/national-security/tactical-isr, and beyond https://www.skydio.com/solutions.

About the Role:

Our customers depend on our drones to protect lives and serve their communities.  Every minute of every day, our drones are dispatched to deliver urgently needed data.  Getting that data from the scene to our users depends on having “always on” connectivity.   We're seeking a technical partnership manager to spearhead collaborations with leading telecom providers, ensuring that our drones can operate wherever our customers need them to.

Location: This is an office-based position that requires 5 days/week onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.


How you'll make an impact:

 - Develop and implement our strategy for engaging with telecom carriers that both deepens our existing relationships and expands our ecosystem to new partners within the US, North America, and internationally over time.

 - Understand our customers’ needs and negotiate agreements with telecom carriers that serve those needs by enabling network access, providing sufficient data connectivity, and building sustainable business partnerships.

 - Understanding and advocating for our customers in-flight data connectivity by providing simple and easy-to-use connectivity options from the first boot of a drone after it is taken out of the box.

 - Build the business models that support in-flight data access, and monitor usage and costs to validate those models in practice.

 - Set regulatory and telecom carrier certification priorities to ensure that our drones meet certification standards for both regulators and telecom operators.

 - Build field relationships between telecom partners and Skydio’s field team to support major events such as sports games, parades, and other major public gatherings.

 - Assist Skydio mission success in supporting customers and major incidents.



What makes you a good fit:

 - You have a demonstrated track record of translating customer needs into priorities and driving implementation.  This can take many forms, including working with complex implementation projects directly with customers, building products from scratch, or building complex business relationships.

 - You face complexity without fear.  When given a goal and a complex process with lots of moving parts, you can break down the challenge into meaningful steps, and clearly communicate how each of them moves the ball forward – whether the process is a technical program like device certification, or a business process like negotiating a telecom contract

 - You bring strong analytical skills to problems, and once you develop a plan, you can communicate it throughout both Skydio and our partner organizations.  Working with multiple complex projects and overlapping deadlines does not scare you.

 - You have a technical background, demonstrated by either an engineering or technical degree (such as computer science, telecommunications, or a scientific field), and/or work experience managing complex technical requirements.

 - Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.



Nice-to-haves:

 - Prior work at a growth-stage start-up.  Skydio is growing fast enough that you’ll need to know when to use an existing rule book, as well as when you should burn the existing rule book and write a new one.

 - Interest or experience in wireless communication. You don’t need to be an expert with a patent portfolio, but you will need to be familiar with bit rates, quality of service, and large-scale network operations.  If you don’t come in with this knowledge, you just need to demonstrate that you can learn it quickly.

 - Experience with telecommunications.  We are flexible about what this means.  You might have worked directly at a telecom company (AT&T, Verizon, or T-Mobile), or at one of its major suppliers (like Cisco, Nokia, or Ericsson).  What’s important is that you’re interested in carrier network infrastructure and protocols, and how to apply them to new solutions.

 - Familiarity or interest in how to apply new 5G features, such as dynamic slicing, high-reliability and low-latency communications, and radio resource management, for airborne devices.



Compensation: The annual base salary range for this position is  $230,000 - $285,000*. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. In addition to base salary, Skydio full-time employees are eligible to enroll in our benefit plans and take advantage of a variety of incentives and stipends. *Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position's location.
